characters.continuity: Marvel Cinematic Universe (Spider-Man: No Way Home)
characters.summary: Otto Octavius fights using four highly durable, telepathically controlled mechanical tentacles mounted to his spine. He combines brilliant scientific intellect with brutal physical restraint and crushing strikes from his appendages.

mechanisms: Mechanical tentacles acting as physical shields

weaknesses: Inhibitor chip failure leading to psychological influence by the arms
Vulnerable to having his mechanical appendages overridden or hacked with Stark/Stark-level tech
limitations: Dependent on his spinal harness and mechanical arms for superhuman capability.

sources.supports: General character history, mechanical arms, and appearances.

feats.claim: Restrained Peter Parker using his mechanical tentacles during their highway clash.

notableResults.note: Ambushed Spider-Man on the highway and extracted nanotech.

campaignTags.claim: Mechanical tentacles controlled via neural interface.

unknowns: Exact limits of the nanotech absorption capabilities when interfaced with Stark tech.

characters.summary: Doctor Doom is not officially a prominent character in the primary MCU continuity as of current major releases, though his multiversal presence and legacy are referenced.
weaknesses: Arrogance and overconfidence in his own superiority
limitations: Human physical body underneath the armor.

feats.claim: Combines advanced science and sorcery to challenge major heroes.

unknowns: Specific canonical MCU feat roster pending full integration in upcoming films.

characters.summary: Doctor Doom wielding the immense cosmic might of the Beyonders, granting near-omnipotent reality-warping capabilities.
limitations: Power source relies entirely on captured cosmic entities.
characters.formDifferences: Replaces standard armor and sorcery limits with absolute reality-warping control derived from the Beyonders.

feats.claim: Created Battleworld out of the remnants of destroyed universes.

notableResults.note: Killed Thanos effortlessly by ripping out his skeleton.

campaignTags.claim: Can tear open dimensional rifts with cosmic power.

unknowns: Exact limitations of his omnipotence without external disruptions.

characters.summary: A futuristic incarnation of Victor von Doom operating in the year 2099, utilizing advanced cyberpunk technology, digital consciousness transfer, and futuristic armor.
weaknesses: Vulnerability to advanced futuristic software exploits and EMPs
limitations: Dependent on futuristic energy supplies and network access.
characters.formDifferences: Replaces medieval-style sorcery and classic armor with 2099 cyberpunk technology and digital consciousness backup.

feats.claim: Conquered the United States of the future using advanced technology and tactical brilliance.

campaignTags.claim: Futuristic cyberpunk gadgets and computer systems.

unknowns: Full extent of his interaction with mainstream Marvel timelines.

characters.summary: God Emperor Doom rules Battleworld as an absolute deity with the combined power of the Beyonders, holding total life-and-death authority over his domain.
weaknesses: Psychological blind spots regarding his own secret doubts and guilt
limitations: Power can be stripped if the source conduit (Molecule Man) is separated from him.
characters.formDifferences: Elevates Doctor Doom to supreme deity status with universal creation powers, far exceeding standard armor and magic.

sources.supports: God Emperor Doom status, domain over Battleworld, and powers.

feats.claim: Reshaped the fragmented remnants of the multiverse into a single planet, Battleworld.

notableResults.note: Killed Doctor Strange when Strange challenged his authority.

campaignTags.claim: Creates dimensional boundaries and portals across realms.

unknowns: Whether his godhood could function outside the structured reality of Battleworld.

characters.id: mcu:Doctor Doom|Infamous Iron Man (Victor von Doom)
characters.summary: Victor von Doom adopts the mantle of the Infamous Iron Man, using high-tech armor and a fusion of science and sorcery to fight crime and redeem his legacy.
weaknesses: Distrust from heroes and public due to his past villainy
limitations: Relies on suit power levels and internal diagnostics.
characters.formDifferences: Replaces traditional monarchical green tunic and cloak with a sleek Iron Man-inspired armor suit carrying both repulsors and magic.

sources.supports: Infamous Iron Man series premise, armor, and Victor von Doom's redemption arc.

feats.claim: Defeated various criminal syndicates while operating publicly as the Infamous Iron Man.

campaignTags.claim: Wears advanced Iron Man-style powered armor.
Utilizes mystic arts alongside advanced armor systems.

characters.summary: Doctor Doom trains extensively in the mystic arts, nearly becoming the Sorcerer Supreme of Earth, combining supreme magical prowess with his intellect and armor.

mechanisms: Powered armor enchanted with protective runes

weaknesses: Vulnerable to powerful cosmic entities and magical backslash
limitations: Requires verbal incantations and somatic gestures for advanced spells.
characters.formDifferences: Enhances base magical capabilities to rival top-tier sorcerers like Doctor Strange.

sources.supports: Doctor Doom's proficiency in magic and competition for Sorcerer Supreme.

feats.claim: Traveled to hell annually to attempt to rescue his mother's soul, mastering complex dark magic.
feats.citation: Doctor Strange and Doctor Doom: Triumph and Torment

campaignTags.claim: Master of mystic arts and contender for Sorcerer Supreme.
Opens mystical gateways to other dimensions.

unknowns: Full duration of his tenure as official Sorcerer Supreme in alternate runs.

characters.summary: Stephen Strange is a master of the mystic arts who wields eldritch magic, dimensional portals, and powerful magical artifacts like the Cloak of Levitation to manipulate reality and subdue foes.

mechanisms: Cloak of Levitation evasion and active blocking

weaknesses: Human physical durability when magical defenses are bypassed
limitations: Requires hand gestures and focus to weave complex spells.

sources.supports: MCU Doctor Strange abilities, mystic arts, and magical items.

feats.claim: Trapped Thanos in temporary restraints using mystical serpents on Titan.

notableResults.note: Fought fiercely using multiple magical clones and artifacts but was ultimately overwhelmed.

campaignTags.claim: Master of the Mystic Arts casting various spells.
Flight granted by the sentient Cloak of Levitation.
Opens sling ring portals for instant travel across dimensions.
Wields the Cloak of Levitation and various mystical artifacts.

unknowns: Full potential of darkhold-corrupted spellcasting limits.

characters.summary: Doctor Strange operating as a member of the Black Priests, utilizing destructive words of power capable of annihilating entire universes and wielding reality-shattering authority.
weaknesses: Strain of uttering catastrophic universal words
limitations: Dependent on specialized esoteric knowledge of universal syntax.
characters.formDifferences: Replaces standard mystic arts and Hand gestures with silent or spoken multiversal concepts and words of absolute destruction.

sources.supports: Black Priests storyline and Doctor Strange's involvement.

feats.claim: Destroyed an alternate Earth by speaking a single catastrophic word.

campaignTags.claim: Wields high-tier multiversal words of power.

unknowns: Permanent effects on Strange's human psyche after using Black Priest magic.

weaknesses: Vulnerable to lethal piercing attacks and overwhelming dark magic
